content:
The test image shows:
- **White cottony/fluffy mycelium** covering the stem
- **Black sclerotia** (irregular black bodies) embedded on/in the stem tissue
- Bleached/tan stem tissue with browning necrosis
- Ground-level stem infection

The White Mold reference images match perfectly — same white mycelial growth on stems with distinctive black sclerotia. Charcoal Rot is clearly different (dark internal stem discoloration, microsclerotia inside pith, no external white mycelium).
